entries.name: Power in Light
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Smite and Penance spells deal $m1% increased damage to targets afflicted with your Holy Fire.

entries.name: Wand Specialization
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your damage with Wands by $s1%.

entries.name: Twin Disciplines
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage and healing of your instant cast spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Silent Resolve
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the threat generated by your Holy spells by $s1% and reduces the duration of Stun, Fear, and Silence effects inflicted on you by $m2%.

entries.name: Holy Precision
entries.descriptionTemplate: Improves your chance to hit with Holy spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Power Word: Shield
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the damage absorbed by your Power Word: Shield by $s1%.

entries.name: Martyrdom
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $m1% chance to gain Focused Casting for $27828d after being the victim of a melee or ranged critical strike. The Focused Casting effect prevents you from losing casting time when taking damage and increases your resistance to Interrupt effects by $27828s2%.

entries.name: Mental Agility
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the mana cost of your Smite, Holy Fire, and instant cast spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Inner Focus
entries.descriptionTemplate: When activated, reduces the Mana cost of your next spell by $s1% and increases its critical effect chance by $s2% if it is a non-periodic spell and capable of a critical effect.

entries.name: Meditation
entries.descriptionTemplate: Allows $s1% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

entries.name: Improved Inner Fire
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the Armor bonus of your Inner Fire spell by $s1% and increases its total charges by $m2.

entries.name: Mental Strength
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your total Intellect by $m1%.

entries.name: Soul Warding
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown on your Power Word: Shield spell by ${$m1/-1000} sec and reduces its mana cost by $s2%.

entries.name: Improved Mana Burn
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Mana Burn spell by ${$m1/-1000}.1 sec.

entries.name: Penance
entries.descriptionTemplate: Launches a volley of holy light at the target, causing $402284s1 Holy damage to an enemy, or $402289s1 healing to an ally, instantly and every $402261t2 sec for $402261d.

entries.name: Renewed Hope
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your heals from Flash Heal, Binding Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, and Penance gain $m1% increased critical strike chance when cast on targets with Weakened Soul, and reduce the remaining duration of Weakened Soul on their target by ${$m2/-1000} sec.

entries.name: Divine Aegis
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your critical heals create a protective shield on the target, absorbing $s1% of the amount healed. Lasts $431624d.

entries.name: Power Infusion
entries.descriptionTemplate: Infuses the target with power, increasing their spell damage and healing done by $s2% for $d.

entries.name: Twilight Focus
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $s1% chance to avoid interruption caused by damage while casting any spell.

entries.name: Improved Renew
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the amount healed by your Renew spell by $s1%.

entries.name: Holy Specialization
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Spell Warding
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces all spell damage taken by $s1%.

entries.name: Divine Fury
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the casting time of your Smite, Holy Fire, Heal, and Greater Heal spells by $/1000;S1 sec.

entries.name: Holy Nova
entries.descriptionTemplate: Causes an explosion of holy light around the caster, causing $s1 Holy damage to all enemy targets within $a1 yards and healing all party members within $23455a1 yards for $23455s1. These effects cause no threat.

entries.name: Blessed Recovery
entries.descriptionTemplate: After being struck by a melee or ranged critical hit, or suffering more than $m2% of your maximum Health from a single attack, heal $s1% of the damage taken over $27813d. Refreshing this effect carries over any remaining healing.

entries.name: Inspiration
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your non-periodic critical heals increase your target's Armor by $m1% for $14893d.

entries.name: Holy Reach
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the range of your Smite and Holy Fire spells and the radius of your Prayer of Healing and Holy Nova spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Healing
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the Mana cost of your Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal, Penance, and Prayer of Mending spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Searing Light
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Holy damage done by $m1%, and gives a $m2% chance each time your Holy Fire spell deals periodic damage for your next Holy Nova to cost no Mana.

entries.name: Binding Heal
entries.descriptionTemplate: Heals a friendly target and the caster for $s1. Low threat.

entries.name: Litany of Light
entries.descriptionTemplate: When you cast a healing spell, gain Mana equal to $m1% of the base cost of the spell if your previous heal was a different spell.

entries.name: Spirit of Redemption
entries.descriptionTemplate: Upon death, the priest becomes the Spirit of Redemption for $27827d.  The Spirit of Redemption cannot move, attack, be attacked or targeted by any spells or effects.  While in this form the priest can cast any healing spell free of cost.  When the effect ends, the priest dies.

entries.name: Spiritual Guidance
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your spell healing by up to $s2% of your total Spirit and your spell damage by up to $s1% of your total Spirit.

entries.name: Spiritual Healing
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the amount healed by your spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Prayer of Mending
entries.descriptionTemplate: Places a spell on the target that heals them for ${($m1+($bh*$bc))*$<mult>} the next time they take damage or receive non-periodic healing. When the heal occurs, Prayer of Mending jumps to a party or raid member within $401880a1 yards. Jumps up to $s2 times and lasts $401877d after each jump. This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

entries.name: Holy Specialization
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the critical effect chance of your Holy spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Shadow Focus
entries.descriptionTemplate: Improves your chance to hit with Shadow spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Blackout
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives your Shadow damage spells a $m1% chance to stun the target for $15269d.

entries.name: Spirit Tap
entries.descriptionTemplate: Gives you a $m1% chance to increase your Spirit by $15271s1% for $15271d after killing a non-trivial target or when an enemy afflicted by your Vampiric Embrace dies. For the duration, $15271S2% of your Mana regeneration will continue while casting.

entries.name: Shadow Affinity
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the threat generated by your Shadow spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Shadow Word: Pain
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the duration of your Shadow Word: Pain spell by ${$s1/1000} sec.

entries.name: Shadow Reach
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases the range of your offensive Shadow spells by $s1%.

entries.name: Improved Mind Blast
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Mind Blast spell by $/1000;S1 sec.

entries.name: Improved Psychic Scream
entries.descriptionTemplate: Reduces the cooldown of your Psychic Scream spell by $/1000;s1 sec.

entries.name: Mind Flay
entries.descriptionTemplate: Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing $o1 Shadow damage over $d  and slowing their movement speed by $m2%.

entries.name: Improved Mind Flay
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Mind Flay now deals $s1% more damage, gains $s2 yards increased range, but slows the target's movement speed by ${$s4-($m3)}%.

entries.name: Improved Fade
entries.descriptionTemplate: Decreases the cooldown of your Fade ability by $/1000;s1 sec.

entries.name: Vampiric Embrace
entries.descriptionTemplate: Afflicts your target with Shadow energy that causes all party members to be healed for $s1% of any Shadow spell damage you deal for $d.

entries.name: Shadow Weaving
entries.descriptionTemplate: Your Shadow damage spells have a $s1% chance to increase the Shadow damage you deal by $15258s1% for $15258d, stacking up to $15258u times.

entries.name: Silence
entries.descriptionTemplate: Silences the target, preventing them from casting spells for $d and interrupting their spellcasts for $1241057d.

entries.name: Devouring Contagion
entries.descriptionTemplate:
Reduces the mana cost of your Devouring Plague by $s1%.

Targets that die while Devouring Plague is active spreads it, jumping to a nearby enemy within $s2 yds for the remaining duration.

entries.name: Early Demise
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below $s2% health by $s1%.

entries.name: Darkness
entries.descriptionTemplate: Increases your Shadow damage done by $s1%.

entries.name: Shadowform
entries.descriptionTemplate: Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by $s2%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by $m4%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by $m5%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by $s3%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.
